summary.text: Lei Tan is a rank six Gu Immortal of Immortal Crane Sect, named when he presses He Feng Yang over defending Fang Yuan in Shang Qing pavilion.

claims.text: In Shang Qing pavilion, his thunderous voice shakes the windows as he asks He Feng Yang how there can be such a mistake in the matter He Feng Yang was in charge of, and what motives He Feng Yang has in defending Fang Yuan though Fang Yuan is not a sect disciple. He is at loggerheads with He Feng Yang amid faction conflict inside Immortal Crane Sect. He snickers that a tiny elite disciple’s relative is not worth the whole sect’s backing, and presses how much compensation the nine sects will demand.
He has a muscular body. His blue hair points toward the sky.

He Feng Yang only smiles without answering his question, and supreme third elder explains the intent to claim Fang Yuan so Immortal Crane Sect alone can seize Hu Immortal blessed land. Lei Tan’s gaze flickers and he stops asking. When He Feng Yang challenges whether Lei Tan would dare climb under land spirit pressure, Lei Tan snorts, wants to retort, and keeps quiet. He later scoffs at the plan’s opening after calamity, then sits down in anger as the atmosphere turns toward He Feng Yang. When Supreme Grand Elder puts He Feng Yang in charge, Lei Tan feels stifled, then is joyous when He Feng Yang must hand over one’s own way Gu for Feng Jiu Ge’s demand.
After Fang Yuan offers rockmen trade, He Feng Yang thinks the batch can show results to the supreme elders and make Lei Tan shut up.

A year after Fang Yuan seized Hu Immortal blessed land, He Feng Yang feels rising sect pressure, especially from his enemy Gu Immortal Lei Tan, who has publicly ridiculed his incompetence several times. He Feng Yang almost hears Lei Tan’s mockery at the coming sect convention if he shows no progress, and thinks success would shut mouths of petty people like Lei Tan.

When first supreme elder says Immortal Crane Sect has no justifiable reason to reject Feng Jiu Ge’s request for Old Lord Can Yang on the northern plains expedition, Lei Tan smiles silently and does not conceal his schadenfreude.
After the ambush at Hu Immortal blessed land, He Feng Yang thinks that if he returns in failure his rival Gu Immortal Lei Tan will definitely seek him out to mock him personally.

At a sect meeting he stands with a muscular body and blue hair pointed toward the sky, saying he has been in charge of reincarnation battlefield matters for over thirty years, that the sect suffered a huge mid-year loss there, and that he needs a rank six Gu Immortal’s battle strength or three desolate beasts, including a nine palace crane. After voting he obtains two desolate beasts and looks at He Feng Yang in hatred. When Hu Immortal blessed land is discussed, he snorts, throws He Feng Yang an ill-intentioned glance, and questions why there is still no progress after more than a year. He mocks the request for Old Lord Can Yang and Fairy Cang Yu as using an ox cleaver to kill a chicken. He Feng Yang then learns from a letter that Old Lord Can Yang is being requested for northern plains, and second supreme elder says the sect cannot reject that request.

Even after Immortal Crane Sect restabilizes Great Heavenly Sword Sect as a subsidiary, the sect is heavily suppressed on the reincarnation battlefield. Lei Tan, the Gu Immortal stationed there, is heavily injured and has to return to the sect to recuperate, pulling Immortal Crane Sect attention back to that battlefield.
